The structure is described in an orthorhombic cell with lattice parameters a = 7.11 Å, b = 5.33 Å, and c = 9.75 Å [[param:cell.a]] [[param:cell.b]] [[param:cell.c]], with all interaxial angles equal to 90° [[param:cell.alpha]] [[param:cell.beta]] [[param:cell.gamma]]. The input cell contains 12 atoms [[param:input.atom_count]], comprising 4 Mg atoms and 8 Tb atoms [[param:composition.Mg]] [[param:composition.Tb]].

The crystallographic symmetry is that of space group number 62 [[param:space_group.number]], with the Hall symbol "-P 2ac 2n" [[param:space_group.hall]], corresponding to the standard setting Pnma. The transformation from the input frame to the standard frame is the identity matrix with no origin shift [[param:frame.matrix]] [[param:frame.origin_shift]], so the input and standard coordinate frames coincide. Fractional coordinates are recorded to three decimal places [[param:round_digits]].

The 12 atoms are distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits, each of multiplicity 4 and each occupying the 4c site with the coordinate relation (x, 1/4, z), so that x and z are free parameters while y is fixed at 1/4. Two of these orbits are terbium sites and one is a magnesium site, accounting for the 8 Tb and 4 Mg atoms in the cell.

The first terbium orbit, o000 [[param:orbit.o000.id]], is a Tb site with Wyckoff label 4c [[param:orbit.o000.element]] [[param:orbit.o000.wyckoff]] and free parameters x = 0.318 and z = 0.416 [[param:orbit.o000.parameters]]. The second terbium orbit, o001 [[param:orbit.o001.id]], is likewise a Tb 4c site [[param:orbit.o001.element]] [[param:orbit.o001.wyckoff]] with x = 0.467 and z = 0.728 [[param:orbit.o001.parameters]]. The magnesium orbit, o002 [[param:orbit.o002.id]], is an Mg 4c site [[param:orbit.o002.element]] [[param:orbit.o002.wyckoff]] with x = 0.247 and z = 0.124 [[param:orbit.o002.parameters]]. No precision corrections are present; the reported coordinates stand as the refined values relative to the idealized Wyckoff positions.
